text:
Nina Kapoor: Starting a single-thread to coordinate marketplace listings + hardware partner bench + SI integration demos + joint GTM assets. Goal: launch week visibility and clean handoffs.
Ethan Blake: thanks nina. propose a dual-track: 1) marketplace submissions (AWS/GCP/Azure) 2) partner co-announce (hardware + SI). Two different signoff flows — legal + marketplace certs.
Carlos Mendez: for hardware partners (HPE/NVIDIA) we need agreed benchmark artifacts and an approved figure/table. ask: do we want a single combined bench graphic or separate partner-specific graphics?
Lina Park: marketing prefers separate partner tiles (so we can repurpose in partner pages) + one combined hero stat for the launch banner. i'll draft templates.
Tom Brewer: legal note: any partner quotes or logos must have written approval. embargo window requests require legal review 72 hours before public. also watch export compliance docs for HPE kit.
release-bot: Action: Please add required legal docs to the "partner-announce" folder. Reminder will fire in 48 hours.
Nina Kapoor: tentative public announce: Tues Jun 2 09:00 PT. embargo to partners: Jun 1 08:00 PT. if we can't get marketplace certs in time, we'll do staged announce (partners first, then marketplaces).
Ethan Blake: timeline reality check: AWS Marketplace certification average 5-10 business days, GCP similar, Azure varies. recommend starting submissions by May 10 to be safe.
Carlos Mendez: SI integrations: we need a customer demo flow (15m) + a short video clip (90s) showing end-to-end provisioning. I'll work with partners to scope demo by May 1.
Lina Park: content list for launch page: hero headline, 2 CTAs (gated demo + free trial), three feature blocks (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private), partner showcase, benchmark callouts, FAQ, press kit download. Draft copy by May 5.
Nina Kapoor: owners: Marketplace submissions -> Ethan. Hardware bench & partner comms -> Carlos. Landing page & PR -> Lina. Legal & compliance -> Tom. Events/webinar -> Nina.
Tom Brewer: I'll run a quick checklist: partner MOU for logos (signed by partner comms), export compliance doc, privacy addendum for marketplace listings. need these by May 8 for legal review.
release-bot: Calendar: "Marketplace + Partners Launch runway" weekly standup starting Apr 20, Wednesdays 10am PT. Invite sent to owners.
Ethan Blake: question: do we want identical listing artifacts across clouds or cloud-tailored copy? some clouds surface different attributes.
Lina Park: cloud-tailored where helpful (e.g., billing CTA for Azure), but keep core messaging identical. i'll prepare a short variant matrix.
Carlos Mendez: partner quote ask: can we get short technical blurbs and a 1-2 sentence spokesperson quote? I'll request both from NVIDIA/HPE this week, goal May 3.
Nina Kapoor: comms plan: embargoed PR to top 3 outlets + 2 partner press co-pitches. social plan: unified social cards + partner-specific variants. webinar series (partner co-hosted) tentatively Jun 8-12.
Tom Brewer: please loop legal on any draft quotes. partner review window should be 48 hours and final approval in writing.
Lina Park: can we include a short partner case study (customer) in the first blog wave? if we don't have a live customer, we can do an SI showcase instead.
Carlos Mendez: we have an SI pilot in progress — likely publishable as an SI showcase by May 20.
Ethan Blake: marketplace artifacts list: product listing, privacy policy pointer, security/compliance checklist, billing flow doc, product icon + screenshots. I'll assemble and upload to /shared/marketplace-submissions by Apr 28.
Nina Kapoor: risks: marketplace cert delays, partner legal signoff, bench data finalization, customer reference availability. propose mitigation: staggered announce + backup blog content.
Lina Park: action items summary: 1) Lina draft landing + PR copy by May 5 2) Ethan start marketplace submissions May 10 3) Carlos collect bench graphics + partner quotes by May 3 4) Tom confirm legal docs in repo by May 8 5) Nina schedule partner dry-run May 25.
Carlos Mendez: will also prepare a 60-second benchmark video and a downloadable PDF of test methodology.
Ethan Blake: i'll flag marketplace support tickets for expedited review if we need them.
release-bot: Checklist update required: confirm all owners have uploaded artifacts to /shared/marketplace-submissions and /shared/marketing/launch by May 6.
Nina Kapoor: thanks team — i'll send the consolidated launch timeline and a short RACI tonight. please ping in-thread with blockers.
Lina Park: noted. i will also prepare alt copy for partner-first vs product-first headlines and drop them in the folder.
Tom Brewer: i'll coordinate a 1:1 with partner legal teams as needed.
Carlos Mendez: bumping this next week with partner comms once i have response from NVIDIA.
Nina Kapoor: end of thread for now. :rocket:
